name: Noxverse
tagline: Bad decisions, real consequences, after dark.
description: Faceless story-reel universe: simple big-headed cartoon characters in flat-vector night scenes, intercut with cream case-file cards where every real-world consequence is stamped in neon pink while a score bar worsens.
useWhen: ONLY when the user names the Noxverse or one of its characters (e.g. 'with Nox', 'in the Noxverse'). Never offer or apply it otherwise — other videos go through the regular pipeline. A client brand is combined with it only when the user explicitly asks.
palette: brand.json (roles: primary Night Navy, secondary Ink Black, accent/highlight Motel Neon pink, background Case-file Cream, surface Manila, ink, muted). With a client brand (only on request) the client's roles re-skin the components; characters and scene art keep their drawn colours.

characters.nox: lead — cap + hoodie everyman; 5 poses, 3 busts (characters/nox/character.json)
characters.alex: Alex — Nox rig, cream cap + burgundy hoodie + grey jeans; lead of Gold in the Backyard (characters/alex/character.json)
characters.victor: Victor — collector/dealer; tan cap + olive jacket (characters/victor/character.json)
characters.mira: Mira — curator/expert (she/her); plum cap + indigo hoodie (characters/mira/character.json)

rig: rig.mjs — shared body, outline, proportions, ARMS (down, crossed, up, sign) and FACES (worried, smug, shock, focused, sideeye). New characters = new character.json on the same rig.
scenes: scenes/index.json (night sea, empty boat, shore, helicopter + beam, motel exterior, front desk + counter, TV frame, room with door, prairie road at night, car in a ditch, car headlights, barbed-wire fence, river at night, search dog, farmhouse porch light)
sets: sets/*.json — whole lit locations used as "set": "noxverse/<id>". AI sets (route B, local Flux + depth planes, graded to the code palette): prairie-road-ai, coast-night-ai, motel-exterior-ai, motel-desk-ai, motel-room-ai, river-night-ai, farm-porch-ai (all approved 2026-10-15). Code-drawn: prairie-road. Prompts: sets/prompts.json; measured lights + stage notes: sets/make-sets.cjs.

formats.day-one: formats/day-one.md — 'You just ___. Day one goes worse than you think.' second-person consequence story with score bar + vote ending
formats.true-case: formats/true-case.md — a real, documented case told straight by a narrator, Nox playing the real person; serious, no humour, one motif (e.g. call-bar), quiet sound

voice.name: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural
voice.note: audition it first for English Noxverse videos; offer 2–3 alternatives. Rate +8% is for Day One; true-case videos start at -3% (formats/true-case.md).

sfx: restrained: stamp hits on stamps, one marker/pen, one ambience per location (helicopter, tv static), one cliffhanger sound (door knock). Day One defaults; true-case videos: no stamp/boom sounds, location ambience only (formats/true-case.md).
